text: So, just looking at the panels here, I think that panel 11 looks pretty different just because it has really hardly any spread at all when you're looking at the teal plot, whereas most of the other graphs or most of their plots do have some spread, meaning that their quartiles are not necessarily evenly spread apart, but definitely have some variation there, whereas in number 11, a couple of them are really, really close together and then also lack some outliers because 11 has one outlier that is way, way, way to the right, meaning it's a really, really significant outlier, which is not something that I see with any of those other graphs.
